author: Videogamehorsey
quote:
So where do i start with a travesty like this, the controls range from floaty and imprecise to completely broken. The rhythm mini-games are ripping off guitar-hero.
And dont get me started on the shooting... Okay the shooting is awful, visually though the game is a masterpiece of being absolutely unplayable sub 30 fps abomination. 
And theres no multiplayer! THERES NO MULTIPLAYER?! uhmmm 0...
